items.a: A small, polished support button you drop onto your own website, so your supporters can pay without leaving your page.

items.q: Do I need a separate account or page for my visitors?
items.a: No. The button works right on your site. There is an optional hosted page for people who prefer one, but you do not need it.

items.q: How is this different from the donation tools I already know?
items.a: Most tools have earned their place. Ko-fi charges nothing on tips and Buy Me a Coffee has the friendliest brand around. Both send your visitor to their page to pay. QuietJar keeps them on yours, so more of them finish.

items.q: Can I use it alongside GitHub Sponsors or Patreon?
items.a: Yes. GitHub Sponsors is the right default on your repo. QuietJar is for your site, where most of your readers actually are. Use both.

items.q: Will it slow down my site?
items.a: No. QuietJar is built to be fast. It loads lightly and does not weigh your page down.
No monthly fee. No plans to compare. QuietJar takes 5% of what you receive, capped at €[TODO: cap] per payment. It costs you nothing until it is earning you something.

items.q: What payment methods can my supporters use?
items.a: Apple Pay, Google Pay, cards, iDEAL, Bancontact, and SEPA. Your visitors see the method they already use, not a card form.

items.q: Will my visitors trust paying on my site?
items.a: They pay through the same regulated rails as any checkout. What they see is Apple Pay, Google Pay, or their own bank's iDEAL screen. Nothing unfamiliar, nothing to type.

items.q: What happens after someone supports me?
items.a: QuietJar steps back. It stops pestering people who have already given, so your biggest supporters get thanked instead of nagged.

items.q: Is my data and my supporters' data in the EU?
items.a: Yes. Payments and data stay on European infrastructure, and there is no cookie banner because there is nothing to consent to.

items.q: How do I add it to my site?
items.a: Paste a small piece of code, pick your design, and it is live. It takes minutes, and it fits the look of your page.

cta.title: Stop losing supporters on the way to the checkout.
cta.description: Add the button to your site in minutes. No redirects. Just a quiet, polished way for your people to support you.
